newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Heineken falls 3.4 pct on report rumours.
newsitem.headline: Heineken falls 3.4 pct on report rumours.

text.p: Shares in Dutch brewing giant Heineken fell 10.20 guilders, or 3.4 percent, amid rumours of negative analyst comment on the European beer market, dealers said.
Dealers said Goldman Sachs analysis had been interpreted as being negative for the sector.
But Goldman's beer analyst Colin Davis denied the bank had downgraded Heineken or the European beer sector recently.
"We have qualified the stock as an underperformer since last September. Nothing has changed," he said.
Dealers said technical factors, with the stock crossing the 300 and 298 guilders support levels, added to fall of the Heineken share.
